verdict.rationale: The axis applies: a password manager and authenticator could plausibly lock itself behind biometrics or a PIN. However, no evidence item documents a biometric or PIN app lock. Community comments only wish for fingerprint or biometric unlock on Linux, which merely implies it exists elsewhere and is not affirmative evidence of the capability.

support.subject: As an everyday user, the app itself locks behind biometrics or a PIN, so a borrowed phone doesn't expose my codes
